steps.prompt_exact: Could you make a tiny browser game called Tiny Diner Ticket Time Trial where I race to match short-order tickets to the right plates before the rush timer runs out? Please give me the whole playable HTML.

code_blocks.code:
🍳 Tiny Diner Ticket Time Trial

Pick a ticket, then slap it onto the matching plate before the rush timer runs out.

Time 60
Score 0
Served 0
Streak 0
Press Start Rush.

Order Rail

Plate Window

🍽️ Rush Prep

Match diner tickets to plates. Correct matches score points and build streaks. Wrong plates cost time.

Controls: click or tap a ticket, then click or tap the matching plate. Keyboard: 1-4 select ticket, Q/W/E/R pick plates.
